verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents an official hosted MCP server at https://api.cfo.ai/mcp with a setup guide (`claude mcp add --transport http cfoai ...`), sign-in as the user with no API keys, and tools such as edit_chats and inspect_chats. Through it, agents like Claude Code and Codex can read and change the financial Model, and every change is recorded in the changelog and can be undone. The probe confirms the guide exists, and the pricing page lists the MCP server as a feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting and using the server works as documented.
